text_block_list.text: Around the time our hectic racing days began to settle down, Shinko Windy and I...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
――Hey, lackey!
When are you finally gonna take me!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That hot springs trip I won in the lottery before! I left it in your care, didn't I?!
I had completely forgotten. Come to think of it, she had told me to take her once my schedule settled down.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"A spacious hot spring, delicious meals,
and super fluffy futons..."
Were you not looking forward to all that?
choice_data_list: I've been looking forward to this! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph! Then hurry up and get ready! Make it as soon as possible, got it?!~

And so, a few days later,
I finally went on the long-awaited hot springs trip with Shinko Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oooooh~~! It's so big! Such a splendid place~.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I can't wait! The hot springs and the food♪ All right, I'm gonna enjoy this to the fullest~!
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wheeeew, so warm and cozy, nanoda~

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The food was delicious,
and the dessert was all-you-can-eat...
This is the absolute best~♪
choice_data_list: Shall we head back to our rooms soon?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: No... next time, minion, we're hanging out in your room!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Pillow fight time!
I'm gonna bring every single pillow
from Windy-chan's room too, so get ready~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
—Gyahahaha!!
Lion Dance Attaaaack! CHOMP!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Aaaand now...!
Unleash the wild pillow barrageee~~!!"
The no-rules pillow fight (?) grew heated.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Dwahahaha!
Victory goes to Windy-chan!
choice_data_list: What are the criteria for winning and losing!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "Just a hunch! 'Cause Windy-chan feels like she's hit way more! We're not done yet!"
choice_data_list: (I'll play with them until their heart's content...)

text_block_list.text:
—However, even after getting tired of the pillow fight,
she just kept lounging around the room.
She already looks completely sleepy, though...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Mmmgh... Huh...!
I'm drooling... Ababa...
choice_data_list: Shall we wrap things up soon...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Eeeehhh... I don't wanna...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ......Lackey.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Windy-chan's gonna sleep here today.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Whyyy would you do thaaat~~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: No no no! I don't wanna go hoooome!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: *Chomp!*

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Guuuuughhh... I'm not budging from here even if you pry me off with a crowbar...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Because...
no one is there when I go back to my room.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It's way too big for one person,
you won't be able to settle down...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Let me tell ya, Windy-chan can't even sleep in the dorm room without my roommate there!
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, I feel like I've heard about that before...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay with Windy-chan
not getting enough sleep?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Your trainee is gonna get unhealthy, you know!

Even if you say that,
it's a problem if you don't go back to your room.
choice_data_list: Oh, I just had a great idea.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
—Testing, testing...
Trainer, can you hear me?

I had Shinko Windy return to her own room.
...While keeping our video call connected.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I turned off the lights
and propped my smartphone up by my pillow!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"All that's left is to hop into bed, nano da.
Just wait right there, nano daaa~."

With this, you won't feel lonely...
It's what they call a 'sleep call.'

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Nn-sh... All righty, done.
Trainer, you awake?
Tell me something interesting~"

Beyond the smartphone screen, it's dim.
Only indirect lighting must be on.
Her face with closed eyes is reflected in it.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "...Heheh... Your stories... are so... boriiing......"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "But... tell me... more..."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey... keep your eyes... on me the whole time...
On Windy-chan...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...At your... very closest...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Mnya, mnya...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Gooo... zzzz...
peacefully sleeping..."

I turn off the call.
The sound of peaceful breathing cuts off.
...Well, I should head to sleep soon too.
It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable bond with Shinko Windy...
